name: Trade 10
definition: Details of the foreign exchange trade including Spot\Forward\NDF that is captured.

ExecutionPrice.name: Execution Price
ExecutionPrice.definition: Price of the execution of the trade.

LastQuantity.name: Last Quantity
LastQuantity.definition: Amount of trade in trading currency.

SettlementType.name: Settlement Type
SettlementType.definition: Specifies the settlment period of the foreign exchange trade.

SettlementDate.name: Settlement Date
SettlementDate.definition: Specifies the date on which the trade will be settled.

ValuationRate.name: Valuation Rate
ValuationRate.definition: Specifies the valuation rate used for the trade.

ForwardPoints.name: Forward Points
ForwardPoints.definition: Specifies the forward points of the trade if needed.

CalculatedCounterpartyCurrencyLastQuanti.name: Calculated Counterparty Currency Last Quantity
CalculatedCounterpartyCurrencyLastQuanti.definition: Amount of trade in corresponding currency.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Specifies the value date of spot transaction.

RiskAmount.name: Risk Amount
RiskAmount.definition: Measurement of the amount of the trade values converted in the US dollars.

FixingCurrency.name: Fixing Currency
FixingCurrency.definition: Specifies the ISO code of the fixing currency.

FixingDate.name: Fixing Date
FixingDate.definition: Date at which the rate determination is made in the NDF trade.

OptionIndicator.name: Option Indicator
OptionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the spot trade is produced by the option.

DeltaIndicator.name: Delta Indicator
DeltaIndicator.definition: Indicate the trade whether it's exchange delta.

AssociatedTradeReference.name: Associated Trade Reference
AssociatedTradeReference.definition: Some associated trade reference needs to be specified.
